summary: Dependency resolved from off-registry HTTPS URL, giving a third-party host control of installed code
details: package.json line 12 declares its sole dependency, "linker-client-string-async", as a bare HTTPS URL (https://artifacts.koliroute.com/npm/linker-client-string-async) instead of a registry version range. On `npm install`, whatever archive that host returns is fetched and installed with no version pin and no integrity verification, and any lifecycle scripts inside it execute on the installer's machine. The shipped package body is a one-line re-export of that dependency, so the manifest line is the entire published surface: the host unrelated to any declared registry or repository controls the code that runs at install time and at require() of index.js, and its contents can change at any time without a new publish of this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
